description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Full Stack Web & eCommerce Engineer based in the United States.
As a Full Stack Web & eCommerce Engineer, you will play a central role in developing and optimizing the digital experiences that drive customer engagement and revenue. You will work across modern web applications, headless eCommerce platforms, marketing websites, and integrated content systems, improving the entire customer journey from discovery to checkout. Collaborating directly with web leadership and cross-functional teams, you will take ownership of technical decisions and deliver high-quality solutions from initial design through production. You will also contribute to technical SEO, AI-powered content automation, analytics, and platform performance. This role offers the opportunity to shape scalable web infrastructure, introduce innovative technologies, and make a measurable impact within a collaborative, fast-moving technology environment.

Accountabilities:
 
 You will lead hands-on development across eCommerce storefronts, marketing websites, integrations, and shared technical infrastructure, ensuring reliable performance and consistent user experiences. Your responsibilities will include:


 
 Lead the ongoing development of a headless eCommerce storefront using Next.js, React, and Vercel, including cart and checkout functionality for commercial, consumer, and academic customers.



 
 Collaborate with web leadership to design, develop, and launch a new academic checkout experience for digital learning products.



 
 Implement and optimize eCommerce analytics, user behavior tracking, and conversion improvements through experimentation and performance analysis.



 
 Develop and maintain marketing websites using React, Gatsby, and headless content management systems, including a dedicated knowledge base.



 
 Implement technical SEO improvements and AI-search optimization through structured data, crawlability enhancements, semantic markup, and performance improvements.



 
 Build AI-assisted content automation pipelines that retrieve relevant news and course information, generate content drafts within a headless CMS, and support human review before publication.



 
 Configure on-demand and incremental build processes to ensure time-sensitive content can be published efficiently without requiring complete website rebuilds.



 
 Maintain Node.js middleware, APIs, and third-party integrations connecting storefront systems with CRM, payment platforms, and other business applications.



 
 Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams on integrations involving single sign-on (SSO), product catalog synchronization, and user provisioning.



 
 Maintain platform security, performance, and reliability through framework upgrades, dependency management, patching, and technical debt reduction.



 
 Improve Core Web Vitals, build times, bundle sizes, and overall application efficiency through continuous optimization and refactoring.



 
 Design and develop user interfaces from Figma concepts through production implementation.



 
 Establish and maintain a scalable design system, including design tokens, reusable React components, and documented interface patterns.



 
 Document technical solutions, workflows, and development decisions to support knowledge sharing and reduce operational dependencies.



 
 Work independently, manage development priorities, collaborate with teammates, and communicate technical trade-offs effectively to marketing, product, and leadership stakeholders.



 
 Evaluate and use AI development tools responsibly, reviewing, testing, and debugging generated code while maintaining high standards of quality and security.




 Requirements :

 The ideal candidate is an experienced full stack developer with strong expertise in modern JavaScript frameworks, eCommerce architecture, API integrations, and content management systems. You should be comfortable owning projects independently, translating design concepts into production-ready applications, and working across technical and business teams. Required qualifications include:


 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Human-Computer Interaction, Design, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience through professional work, coding bootcamps, certifications, or demonstrated projects.



 
 At least 5 years of professional full stack web development experience, with production websites and applications you can demonstrate.



 
 Strong experience with React and TypeScript, including production development using at least one Next.js website and another React framework or static site generator such as Gatsby.



 
 Proven experience developing and maintaining Node.js APIs and third-party integrations using REST, GraphQL, webhooks, and authentication technologies.



 
 Experience integrating eCommerce storefronts or web applications with CRM, ERP, and payment platforms such as HubSpot and Stripe.



 
 Demonstrated experience delivering at least one production eCommerce cart or checkout flow, including payment processing and related edge cases.



 
 Experience working with headless architectures, including headless commerce platforms or headless CMS solutions such as Strapi, Contentful, or Sanity.



 
 Ability to design and implement content models within headless content management systems.




 Additional qualifications and experience that would be advantageous include:


 
 A portfolio demonstrating interfaces designed in Figma and subsequently developed into functional applications.



 
 Experience creating or extending design systems, including design tokens, reusable component libraries, Storybook or similar tools, and technical documentation.



 
 Knowledge of technical SEO, including semantic HTML, Schema.org structured data, website performance, and crawlability optimization.



 
 Experience with BigCommerce Catalyst, headless Next.js storefront development, and related APIs.



 
 Practical experience with HubSpot, including custom objects, properties, forms, workflows, and API integrations.



 
 Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, eCommerce event tracking, A/B testing, and user behavior analytics tools such as Microsoft Clarity.



 
 Experience managing deployments and development environments using platforms such as Vercel, Netlify, or Render, alongside Git-based development workflows.



 
 Proven ability to refactor and optimize existing codebases, with measurable improvements in performance, maintainability, or development efficiency.



 
 Experience applying AI technologies to software development, information discovery, AI search, or large language model (LLM) visibility.



 
 Familiarity with scheduled workflows and applications integrating LLM APIs, such as the Claude API, with human review processes.



 
 Experience implementing or optimizing search platforms such as Algolia.



 
 Knowledge of video platforms and APIs, including video clipping, captions, and transcripts.



 
 Previous experience working within marketing website development or growth-focused teams.



 
 Strong communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and decisions to non-technical stakeholders.



 
 Ability to use AI-assisted development tools effectively while independently understanding, validating, and taking responsibility for all delivered code.




 Benefits :


 
 Annual salary range of $105,500–$123,500 USD.



 
 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage, beginning on the first day of the month following the hire date.



 
 Four weeks of paid parental or medical leave.



 
 Flexible paid time off policy and additional sick leave.



 
 Eight paid holidays annually.



 
 401(k) retirement savings plan available from the beginning of employment.



 
 One complimentary professional development course each year after 90 days of employment.



 
 Tuition assistance to support continued education and career development.



 
 Fully remote work opportunity within the United States.



 
 Opportunity to work with modern web technologies, AI-powered development tools, and scalable eCommerce platforms.



 
 Collaborative environment focused on innovation, professional growth, and impactful digital experiences.
